spans.s: फल् (I) vt. 1P (pp. फुल्त, फुल्ल or फलित in the first sense, only फलित in the second.) 1. To burst open, to split, to cleave asunder; 2. to go.

फल् (II) vi. 1P (pp. फलित) 1. To bear fruit, नानाफलैः फलति कल्पलतेव भूमिः Bhartr.ii.40, कल्पद्रुमा योगबलेन फेलुः Bt.iii.42; 2. to be useful, to be successful, to succeed, to be fruitful in, e.g. फलत्यवल्गु ध्रुवमेव राजन् Bt.xii.66, or नैवाकृतिः फलति नैव कुलं न शीलम्; 3. to result, to have results or consequences, e.g. फलितं तावदस्माकं कपटप्रबंधेन, or एवं च सूत्रं न कार्यमिति फलितम्.

फल n. 1. Fruit especially that of a tree, crop, produce, उदेति पूर्वं कुसुमं ततः फलम् Sak.vii., समित्कुशफलाहरैः R.i.49, Megh.i.16; 2. offspring, progeny, R.xiv.39; 3. result, consequence, effect, आफलोदयकर्मणाम् R.i.5, 20, 53, Megh.i.24; 4. interest, object, किमपेक्ष्य फलम् ‘with what object in view’ Kir.ii.21; 5. profit, gain, advantage; 6. recompense, retribution (good or bad), फलमस्योपहासस्य सद्यः प्राप्यसि R.xii.37; 7. a deed, an act, ब्रुवते हि फलेन साधवो न तु कंठेन निजोपयोगिताम् ‘good men prove their usefulness by deeds, not by words’ Na.ii.48; 8. a shield; 9. a tablet, a board (as in शारीफल); 10. the point of an arrow, the head of a dart; 11. menstrual discharge; 12. a plough-share; 13. a gift; 14. the result of a calculation (in math.); 15. nutmeg.
फाल (I) n. 1. A plough-share, M.vi.16; 2. a garment made of cotton.
फाल (II) m. 1. An epithet of Śiva; 2. of Balarāma; 3. a citron tree.
फल-अनुबंध m. sequence of results.
फल-अनुमेय a. inferable from consequences or results, फलानुमेयाः प्रारंभाः संस्काराः प्राक्तना इव R.i.20.
फल-अन्त m. a bamboo.
फल-अन्वेषिन् a. looking for a reward.
फल-अपेक्षा f. regard to results, expectation of consequences.
फल-अशन m. a parrot.
फल-अस्थि n. a cocoa-nut.
फल-आकांक्षा f. hope or expectation of favourable consequences.
फल-आगम m. the fruit-season, autumn.
फल-आढ्या f. a variety of the plantain.
फल-आसक्त a. acting for the sake of reward.
फल-उत्तमा f. a knt grape without stones.
फल-उत्पत्ति (I) m. a mango tree.
फल-उत्पत्ति (II) f. production of fruit.
फल-उदय m. appearance of fruit, results or consequences, आफलोदयकर्मणाम् R.i.5.
फल-उद्देश m. regard to results.
फल-कामना f. desire of a result or consequence.
फल-काल m. fruit-season.
फल-केशर m. the cocoanut tree.
फल-ग्रह m. the deriving profit or advantage.
फलग्रहि a. bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
फलग्रहि a. bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
फलग्रहि a. bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
फलग्रहि a. bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
फलग्रहि a. bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
फल-तस् ind. consequently, virtually.
फल-द (I) a. 1. bearing fruit, M.xi.142; 2. bringing profit or gain.
फल-द (II) m. a tree.
फल-निवृत्ति f. cessation of consequences.
फल-निष्पत्ति f. production of fruit.
फलपाक m. 1. the ripening of fruit; 2. the fulness of consequences.
फलपाक m. 1. the ripening of fruit; 2. the fulness of consequences.
फल-पादप m. a fruit-tree.
फल-पूर, -पूरक m. common citron.
फल-पूर, -पूरक m. common citron.
फल-प्रदान n. 1. a ceremony at weddings; 2. the giving of fruits.
फल-बंधिन् a. forming or developing fruit.
फल-भूमि f. a place of reward or recompense (as heaven or hell).
फल-भोग m. 1. enjoyment of consequences; 2. usufruct.
फल-योग m. 1. the attainment of an object; 2. remuneration, wages.
फल-राजन् m. the water-melon.
फल-वत् a. 1. fruit-bearing; 2. yielding results, successful, profitable.
फल-वती f. a species of plant (प्रियंगु).
फल-वर्तुल n. a watermelon.
फल-वृक्ष m. a fruit tree.
फल-वृक्षक m. the bread-fruit tree.
फल-श्रेष्ठ m. the mango trec.
फल-साधन n. a means of effecting any result.
फल-सिद्धि f. acquiring fruit, realizing an object.
फल-स्नेह m. a walnut tree.
फल-हारी f. an epithet of Durgā.
फलक n. 1. A shield; 2. any flat surface, धृतमुग्धगंडफलकैः Sis.ix.47, तरुणीकपोलफलकेषु मुहुः; 3. a plank, a board, a slab, a tablet, M.ii.204; 4. a leaf or page for writing on; 5. the buttocks.
फलक-पाणि m. a soldier armed with a shield.
फलक-यंत्र n. an astronomical instrument invented by Bhāskara.
फलन n. 1. Fructifying; 2. producing consequences.
फलिता f. A woman in her courses.
फलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Bearing or yielding fruit (lit. and fig.), इह सर्वत्र फलिनः कुलपुत्रमहाद्रुमाः Mrich.iv.
फलिन् (II) m. A tree.
फलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Bearing or yielding fruit (lit. and fig.), इह सर्वत्र फलिनः कुलपुत्रमहाद्रुमाः Mrich.iv.
फलिनी f. The priyangu creeper.
फलिन (I) a. (f. ना) Fruitful.
फलिन (II) m. The bread-fruit tree.
फलिन (I) a. (f. ना) Fruitful.
फलिनी f. The priyangu creeper.
फल्गु (I) a. 1. Pithless, sapless, unsubstantial, (op. to सार), सारं ततो ग्राह्यमपास्य फल्गु Panch.i.; 2. small, minute; 3. unmeaning, useless, worthless; 4. feeble, insignificant.
फल्गु (II) f. 1. the spring season; 2. name of a sacred river.
फल्गु-उत्सव m. the vernal festival commonly called holī.
फल्गुन m. 1. The month Phālguna; 2. an epithet of Arjuna.

फाल्गुन m. 1. The name of a Hindu month; 2. an epithet of Arjuna; (in this sense the word is thus explained in the Mahābhārata- उत्तराभ्यां फल्गुनीभ्यां नक्षत्राभ्यामहं दिवा । जातो हिमवतः पृष्ठे तेन मां फाल्गुनं विदुः); 3. the name of a tree otherwise called अर्जुन.
फल्गुनी f. The name of a constellation, K.S.vii.6.
फाल्गुनी f. The full-moon-day of the month फाल्गुन.
फल्य n. A flower.
फाल-गुप्त m. an epithet of Balarāma.
फाल्गुन-अनुज m. 1. the month Chaitra; 2. the vernal season; 3. an epithet of नकुल and सहदेव the last two Pāṇḍava princes.
फाल्गुनी-भव m. an epithet of the planet Jupiter.
